notes.title: Phantom Hunter - Sixth Update - Progression & Quests
notes.content:
Hello Phantom Hunters!

This update is a big one! We completely reworked the progression by the addition of the Quest Board!
We hope you enjoy this new update!

The build is 7.0.7beta!

New Features:
- Reworked progression, meaning previous save files will no longer be valid for play, and users will get a new save upon entering.
- Add Quest board with almost 200 quests!--> Quests may give you rewards, character buffs, and new unlockable cards
- There are quests in the following categories: global, character, and level
- User is able to toggle on/off character buffs given by quests in the quest UI
- Added NPC that may show up in levels that gives you extra information and items

Updates:
- Rare Candies now give more Job XP
- Split up locker tutorial into two pieces, one for character / pendants, other for deck editing
- Reworked line trails to only being on player when dashing or when in air
- Killing enemies now give more job XP depending on difficulty
- Multiple ways of gaining job XP because job level is now a requirement for some quests
- Job level max from 5 → 99
- Research pricing reworked to account for massive progression rework
- After level up or exiting options menu, you will be given some time to get your bearings before getting back into the fight
- Updated tutorial level to hopefully teach player how to dash better (can not be walked or jumped around)
- Buy another pack button in soul pack bench

Bug fixing:
- Fix some focus issues for controller across UIs
- Fix too many enemy spawning issue
- Fix issue where line trail disappeared after travelling in all stage
- Fix issue with some companions where they did not go for enemy and got stuck
- Update text usages else where for main and sub weapons
- Fix player line moving while player is interacting with UI

Polishing:
- Bullets now may contain a piercing value, allowing them to go through a number of enemies
- Added some knockback on gun when shooting on ground to give a bit more weight
- Rework level tiling across all levels
- Pack opening styling has been updated
- Breakable blocks now give considerably less power XP
- All stage is now accessible via console
- Updated splash screen to have an animation
- Lessen text on tutorials
- Damage text is smaller and quicker
- General performance improvements when reloading or loading levels
- Do not load unused UI
- Do not check for research / card inventory while in gameplay, for example
- Lessen amount of line trails used, lessen amount of ticks dots do, as some were adding significant FPS drops

We look forward to making the next update and hope you all enjoy!

If you'd like to give feedback:
- Phantom Hunter Discord Channel (https://discord.gg/9AK5Z5rHsP)

- Direct message on Twitter (https://twitter.com/PhantomHuntGame)

- Email (phantomhuntergame@gmail.com)

notes.title: Phantom Hunter - Fifth Update - Scorched Earth! (Minor)
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! This is a bit of a smaller update, but we got lots of polish and bug fixes, and a new set of cards!

The new build is: V6.0.2!

Gameplay:
- Added the “Scorched Earth” Card Set. Check it out! It has lots of new cards and abilities for everybody!
- You should now expect some secrets with soul cards
- Skips are now infinite and do not require upgrades
- Charge weapons like sniper or mega gun now take into account for attack speed
- Attack speed increases have been reworked. Earlier it was easy to break, now it’s more scalable.
- Enemies now give bonus power on posture break
- Reworked Persistent into Stock. Persistent was making the game easy to break. Stock allows limited uses of a card before it's used up
- Dodge can no longer permanently be above 85%

Quality of Life:
- In the trophy room, you now can get a star if you have beaten a level in all stage
- Now can sort cards by level in Character Menu
- Dialogue option buttons are now more apparent
- Cards that are consumed now play an animation
- Player can see cards that were used during gameplay
- Added % to crit and dodge in the level up stats panel
- Sped up loading screen animation
- Sped up skip when you go through event summary
- Sped up animation for pack opening
- Updated cards views and buttons
- Added more debugging info for build number and what the player has equipped to help us look into issues better
- Remove some loading screens when it was unnecessary
- Double prompt on delete data
- Update flamethrower effects to better show new features given by the new cards
- Debuff damage now has icons to let player know where the damage came from
- Updated social media buttons, added a button that links to our youtube channel!

Bugs:
- Fix phantom button in dialogue options for controller
- Fix crashes on all stage with Cursed Ward

We look forward to making the next update and hope you all enjoy! Expect some major progression changes!

If you'd like to give feedback:
- Phantom Hunter Discord Channel (https://discord.gg/9AK5Z5rHsP)

- Direct message on Twitter (https://twitter.com/PhantomHuntGame)

- Email (phantomhuntergame@gmail.com)

notes.title: Phantom Hunter - Fourth Update! Building Power!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! Thanks for your support and feedback while playing the game!

The new build is V5.0.1!

This may be the biggest update yet! 

Updates
New Systems
Deck Editor:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/efa462cde26d782bff40c61fbb8ca01c55faa23c.png
- Players now have full control over the souls they will receive upon power up by way of the brand new deck editor! Access this new system by checking out the red locker at home.
- Added a brief tutorial upon accessing the locker for the first time which explains the new interface as well as some information about types of souls
- You can have up to 20 souls in your soul deck and must have at least 10 souls.
- You are able to save and switch freely between 5 decks. These decks are tied to the currently equipped class and is comprised of the equipped pendant(s) and souls.

Hunter Level(Global player progression):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/bf14cdb8b50562ecf75678b735460e735611d55c.png
- Upon returning home after a hunt or sleeping in any bed you will now be presented with an “Event Summary” screen where any events you have completed since the last time you came home or slept will be tallied up and added to your current Hunter Level EXP.
- When you level up you will be rewarded with a number of Booster Tokens which you can use to buy booster packs!
- You can also purchase booster tokens with ectoplasm in the materials shop.

Booster packs:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/08a9aee747e99400fdae294fe9b8fad6319ea926.png
- There are 3 types of booster packs in the initial release of the new deck building system.
--> Pioneer Basic Pack
----->Contains generic souls that can be used by any class or pendant combination
-->Pioneer Class Pack
----->Contains souls specific to classes (i.e. Scout, Tank, Adventurer, Mega). These souls can only be added to your deck when that particular class is equipped.
-->Pioneer Pendant Pack
----> Contains souls specific to pendants. These souls can be added to your deck when the pendant is equipped.

Soul Rarity:
- Along with the addition of over 200 souls we have also given souls the ability to be upgraded!
When you open a booster pack and receive a duplicate of a soul you already own, that card will gain 1 EXP. When it receives enough EXP it will level up.
- Common and Rare souls can be leveled up a maximum of 3 times. Generally when a soul levels up, any visible numbers in the soul’s effect will increase, although not every level will yield and increase maxing a soul will almost always yield an increase.
- Powerful mythic souls do not gain EXP and therefore cannot be improved beyond their starting power.
- If you receive an additional duplicate for a soul that is already at its maximum level, or a duplicate for a mythic soul you already own, you will instead be rewarded with booster tokens.

Special souls:

Some souls have special attributes or traits which will allow players to really customize how they would like to play the game. Just like before, your soul deck is reset at the beginning of each run

Temporary souls

- These souls are denoted by an hourglass icon in the bottom left corner of the card image. These souls are one time use and generally have a time limit associated with them. For example a soul that temporarily makes you invincible, or gives you a massive speed boost for 20 seconds. There are plenty of temporary souls that have some pretty amazing abilities!

Some souls have special “Traits” that can change the way they appear or even improve their effects depending on certain conditions being met. Souls with traits will have the name of the trait above the soul effect. You can also learn about that trait by simply hovering over the soul in the deck editor or when you power up.

Draw traits 
change the way a soul appears or is consumed.

Eager
- Souls with the eager trait will always appear the very first time you power up during a run.

Persistent
- Souls with the persistent trait will continue to appear when you power up, even if you chosen. The only way to stop a persistent card from appearing is to exile it.

Improvement traits
can increase their effects upon certain conditions being met. These souls have improvement tokens which can be seen on the right side of the soul’s image.

Jealous
- Souls with the jealous trait are improved every time they are not chosen. Most Jealous souls can be improved 5 times

Displacer
- Souls with the displacer trait are improved when any other soul is exiled from your deck. The soul does not have to be currently visible, and exiling a single soul improves every displacer soul currently in your deck. Most displacer souls can be improved 3 times.

Class Changes:

To avoid spoilers we won’t lay out every single class change here, but all classes have new weapons added to their kit via souls obtained in booster packs. Also, all current weapons can be made stronger by leveling up those souls by getting duplicates of them in booster packs.

Tank

reduced the damage of the upgraded rifle - we felt the tank was dealing way too much damage, but we did keep the large amount of AOE you can do.

Adventurer

Adventurer vital ray is renamed to Hero Ray

Increased base weapon damage

Pendant Changes:
- Every pendant has undergone at least a slight change or tweak for both balancing, as well as adding additional souls to the basic kit. Below are some notable changes:

Bloodbane
- Now triggers lifesteal based on damage dealt. By default it triggers its lifesteal effect after dealing 400 damage. This can be reduced by leveling up the soul

Razorstorm
- Razorstorm uptime is now based on time instead of rotations

Gameplay Changes:
- The house has been redesigned to facilitate the new booster pack bench
- New music tracks added for the locker and booster pack bench.
- New complete and looping music added for when you complete each of the existing levels.
- You now draw 4 souls by default on power up instead of 3
- Added the ability to Reroll on a power up (draw 4 more souls)
-When using certain temporary souls a small timer icon will appear above the character to let you know how long that effect will last for
- Added Crate Drop Increase to research bench
- Added Chest appearance increase to research bench

Visual Changes:
- Increased the base resolution of the game to 1920x1080p
- NPCs now have chirp dialogue which will trigger by walking by the character
- Synth/Desynth has been changed to Buy/Sell
- On power up you can now see your current stats
- Damage text has been changed to make crits and debuff attacks more prominent
- Player health bar is slightly raised to make the focus bar easier to see (samurai absorb skill)

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where mouse scroll did not work in the desynth menu
- Borderless windowed should now properly fill the screen on higher resolution displays
- Added background panels to some tooltips to make them easier to see
- Fixed Samurai upgraded secondary able to absorb infinitely
- Fixed some mouse capture issues when player is in UI and unable to exit mouse from window

notes.title: Phantom Hunter - Third Update! (Also a Free Key Giveaway! See bottom of post)
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! Thanks for your support and feedback while playing the game!

The new build is V4.0.5!

Got lots of stuff done this month and we hope you enjoy it.
Now to the list of things we added for this update!


Updates

Research Updates
- Player can now synthesize materials using ecto and desynthesize unused materials into ecto. Go to the research bench to check it out!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/4f7e509b1aac1c9f5f9244add758e28ab5569a09.png
- Majority of research upgrades now require ecto as a base requirement
- Research UI styling has been updated to look nicer (similar to synth)
- Inventory logs now contain item images

Level Updates
- Added new level Crabby Caverns
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/11435f791c329208f896affaec81c74a07f11837.png
- Added new level Radiant Reef
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/c670785782a6de51e4a2b6db5512a37316100bd8.png
- Each level now has difficulties you can unlock, the harder the difficulty, the more reward! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/04049ec072f4dc518be7a76594277dd017d4d489.png
--> Be careful of the bosses on higher difficulties, they may have additional mechanics.
- Normal difficulty is easier than the base difficulty of previous builds. Just by a bit

- Created a trophy room to see what you have done
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/c8ccc3ba86828e7c1f4cce58ca1be16d81429d82.png

Music Updates
- Added music to the credits screen
- There is hub music at home now

General Updates
- Players stowed weapon now shows on their back
- Player invulnerability after getting hit has increased by 33 %
- Did some renovations in the house
- Pendants have in game UI for ones that take a while to load up (like lifesaver)
- UI showing ghostly shard amount in a level after level completion. Helps you know how much more ghostly shards to look for.
- Added a soul deck onboarding for new and existing players when they first level up
- Music Pitch tween after player death, it's more funny this way.
- Added more pendants, some of them are unlocked by default to give player choices at the very beginning. Try out the Satchel pendant!
- Level backgrounds are updated to be parallax
- PDA now has flags to tell you if you have read it or not
- Added Lots of achievements 
- Player can now skip / exile cards (expect some features to come with this soon!)
- Worked on some performance, reduced the amount of times enemy is being checked against things they shouldn't be interacting with.
- Ecto max amount increased as now it is core to lots of upgrades and purchases in the future
- Player now can see ecto amount while in combat

Feedback
- Added option to keep mouse captured in window, which was causing issues of mouse clicking outside of the game
- Added back main menu button in the options menu, but have it double prompt (trying to ensure player doesn't accidentally end their run)
- Added a progress bar to show how long Samurai's warp blade has before auto releasing

Bugs
- Fix bug where heal orbs got stuck in the ground
- Fix typos in some PDA dialogues
- Fix floor tile highlight issue on Level 2
- Hiding gun on Squid boss face
- Healing heart pendant stats were showing incorrectly as 3 instead of 8
- Removed inventory log when 0 of something gets removed
- Fix portal interacting with heal orbs
- Fix interact UI colliding with notifications


We have a new twitter account, follow us for more updates!


If you'd like to give feedback:
- Phantom Hunter Discord Channel (https://discord.gg/9AK5Z5rHsP)

- Direct message on Twitter (https://twitter.com/PhantomHuntGame)

- Email (phantomhuntergame@gmail.com)

FREE KEY GIVEAWAY INSTRUCTIONS
- Join our discord: https://discord.gg/9AK5Z5rHsP
- Tell us your favorite retro game!

First 10 people to follow the instructions will be messaged to get a free steam key!

notes.title: Phantom Hunter - Second Update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! Thanks for your support and feedback while playing the game!

The new build is V3.0.2!

As you may have noticed, we are trying to go for one decent sized update a month. We plan to make new content, as well as address feedback and bugs!

Now to the update!

Updates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/d94cdf32fbe73c78b161d8392b4b936b48883007.gif
New Content!
- New Character - Time Drifter: Harness futuristic gadgets and teleport through mind-bending portals with the all-new character!
- Explore Inkwell Abyss: Dive into the spooky third level filled with seaweed and encounter a giant squid!
- There are a few pendants related to the new content, play to find out what they are!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/37b91fe2df997c0f3bfae603b6adc0025a5eb8a4.gif
Character Menu Update
- You can now wield more than one pendant! You can unlock pendant slots via research table, and start making fun builds and synergies!
- Quick Character Select and Pendant Select in the Character Menu
- Player now can see pendant stats

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/dc985d3736fb4f8e0539a4acde9a22d87b4c5963.gif
- Player can now choose which character they want to unlock by interfacing with the table next to max!
--> Expect the list to grow longer :)

- Player can now see how much ghostly shards are in each level
- Updated the house layout
- You can now sleep in bed
- Added step counter
- Remove Stat Window as Character menu has effectively replaced it
- After you win or lose, there will be notifications to let you know if there's a reason to go back home (purchaseable things, mail, etc.)
- Add git hash in steam build in options menu
- Spinning Bullet Pendant now tracks to closest enemy instead of where player is aiming 
- Made Character menu soul cards look less like buttons
- Allow input type change when player is paused or in menus.
- Made adventurer output a bit more damage
- Made loading screens more fun

ADDRESSED FEEDBACK

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/9be6084de2d107828b25702c57cf77914b7e3a45.gif
Control Screen Update
- Removed binding to press to bring player back to main menu when in pause menu
- Remapping inputs for mouse and keyboard as well as controller
- Added ground pound button (this is for controllers, primarily)
- Duck toggle is now an option in the options menu
- Added ability to change Aiming dead zones for controller

- Update dialogue button hover to be brighter instead of darker
- Dialogue buttons are now a consistent width
- Player can no longer be trained if character is maxed out
- Change color schemes a bit between each level
- Fridge Content! The fridge is no longer empty!
- Change text when you dodge damage to "dodged!"
- Adjusted how enemies spawn, now it trickles in more
- Adjusted round time, now it's a bit longer before boss shows up
- Duck dodging is now a thing

Fixed bugs
- Player sometimes restarted in 1st level while in regular mode
- Chance chest appears, then disappears in front of player. Now if it succeeds, it animates in
- Fix game crash on teleport with minefield master pendant
- PDA had a hardcoded press E to use, removed mention of that. As the keybind shows to the left now.

We hope you have been enjoying our updates!  We appreciate the feedback and looking forward to more.

Feel free to keep upto date by following us on Twitter
https://twitter.com/IchitGame

Or chat to us on our discord server!
https://discord.gg/9AK5Z5rHsP

notes.title: Phantom Hunter - First Update!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, thanks for your support and playing the game!

The new build is v2.0.2!

This update addresses lots of feedback as well as some features, updates, and fixes!

FEATURES
- All stages mode - A challenge mode for those who need a bit more difficulty! You will need to unlock it first!
- Press "C" at home to see character info!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/26c3959a7d62803f6e7eea2cdf4634031916d203.png
Press More Details to learn about how they work. This is important because there are some considerable changes to the existing classes!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798919/2b99934c4f4ff7deb767790cd745e9d1fff0a5eb.png

UPDATES
- In game power upgrades now look more like cards with some art and lets players know where the cards come from
- Reworked the in game UI to be more clean
- All players now can now perform a ground pound when pressing down while in the air! 
--> This can help player to quickly get to the ground, it can also break blocks and deal extra stomp damage on enemies
- Added a special thanks section in credits
- Going forward going to use semantic versioning for builds.
- Tried to make the game more controller friendly.

CHARACTER UPDATES
- Samurai can now absorb bullets with the secondary weapon
- Adventurer now can use a hookshot to get out of sticky situations
- Tank now can enter artillery mode to deal devastating damage
- Jumpman can now create bullet shields when ground pounding to be safe from projectiles
- Scout will speed up after getting hit

ADDRESSED FEEDBACK
- Addressed the level ups feeling insignificant and or super random
- Addressed not knowing what are the special features of classes ("Character info")
- Tank class's damage was a bit underwhelming (which we fixed with artillery mode)
- Player getting knocked back even when in iframes
- Camera acceleration was often not fast enough to keep up with player
- Duck is no longer a toggle, as it was causing issues with wanting to use dash, or using the correct kind of jump.
- Show class level in a run
- Show restart button when you win
- Give rocks some XP when destroyed
- Mega charge shot now deals more damage
- Don't pick up health orbs when health is full -- so players can keep them for later in a battle
- Enemies still could deal contact damage when dying
- Fixed issue where player could get outside of the map
- Allow a small buffer to do the first jump as player runs off platform
- Escape should now close most in game menus
- Show ghostly shards and candy in hub world
- Add a "!" when things are purchasable in the research table!
- Move wounded state to mutation, as it was making it too difficult for players
- Hide PDAs until they are interactable in the level. (Was causing confusion)

We hope you enjoy playing. Looking forward to feedback and continuing to make this game.
